ConnectionStrings._comment: Replace with your Supabase project's connection string — Project Settings > Database > Connection string > .NET tab. Use the DIRECT connection (port 5432), not the pooled/PgBouncer one (6543) — this app is a long-running server, not serverless functions, and PgBouncer's transaction mode doesn't support everything EF Core needs. Never commit a real password here; use an environment variable or user-secrets instead (see README).
